Eternal Forge — accepted static authored procedure
The following text is transcribed from Return247’s accepted spell-local proposal; headings identify source object keys.

## sharedProcedure.access

Preserve Druid/Mage/Wizard native rank 9, minimum class 17, base 26 RP, additional 0 RP, Action and 120 feet. Forge Conjuration V/S/F; Conversion Transmutation V/S/M-or-F. Use actual acquired repertoire, components, focus permission and preparation, not merely class eligibility. No feat, recipe, trade or tool credential is granted.

## sharedProcedure.commitment

Preflight actual choices, perception, line of effect, range, accessible body/lot, authorization, components, Action and final legal price. Before payment, missing authorization/profile or known illegality rejects with no cost. Commit exactly one Action, actual priced RP, chronological Dissonance/Refrain and cast history; then actual Counterspell window. No refund for a counter or late-invalid payload. No extra concentration requirement is added by these spells. Existing concentration changes only through actual interfaces.

## sharedProcedure.classHooks

Prepared Wizard first-family base Dissonance exemption is per real encounter; duplicate matrices do not multiply it. Repeats retain Refrain. Conjuration creature HP bonus does not apply to items. Automatic creation introduces no Arcane Experimentation check. No research success, trade XP, harvest XP, proficiency or item charge comes from spell access.

## sharedProcedure.ordering

NEW spell-local transaction: freeze immutable cast ID, caster/class/school/rank, requested versioned profile and exact target IDs at commitment. At resolution compare target revisions and reservations, then commit all payload mutations atomically. Failed compare-and-swap makes no partial output. Concurrent local transactions use existing initiative then stable actor/cast IDs fixed before declaration. Never retarget after payment. Idempotent event IDs replay no payment, item or charge.

## sharedProcedure.knowledge

Show only legitimately known output profiles and visible availability/costs. Internal hidden refusal facts do not identify secret ingredients, item properties or formulas. Director authorization records a specific permitted profile version; 687 reviewed recipes are not 687 public grants. Preserve 433 public, 39 restricted, 215 Director recipes and 92 restricted materials.

## sharedProcedure.providers

Ready uses its actual paid preparation and Reaction release/expiry contract. Copy/reflection/storage require an acquired provider and its exact eligibility, costs, caster attribution and finite source lineage. No generic free copy and no reliance on unaccepted Cast Echo. If a provider cannot be shown, that route remains unavailable in evidence, not globally forbidden.

## sharedProcedure.state

Persist object/lot ID and revision; root cast and generating rank; parent-child provenance with exact rational quantities; three-dimensional occupied region; material composition and phase; owner/custodian and reservations; damage deficit and maximum/current HP; charges and every processed dawn ID; visibility/knowledge separate from physical truth; caster budgets, regular starts, recharge, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain; costs, failed commitments and terminal reason. Full-state test/replace inverses are evidence rollback only, never in-world refunds.

## spellLocalNEW.output

NEW: one complete authorized magical nonartifact weapon or item per paid cast, not the ordinary recipe batch quantity. A complete profile supplies actual base model, size, physical geometry, mass, AC, current/max HP, equipment slots, ordinary function, enchantment rules, finite uses, source reference value and visibility. Unknown fields require explicit Director content authorization before casting. No general price ceiling or outstanding-item cap.

## spellLocalNEW.creation

NEW: create a new complete physical body; do not transform or consume an ordinary inventory base. A recipe card supplies an output specification only. No recipe work, formula ownership, tool proficiency, ingredients or crafting time are silently imposed. One Action produces the useful authorized item, at maximum standard body HP and its source-defined initial charges once. No Exceptional/Masterwork output or quality upgrade unless separately authorized by a complete profile.

## spellLocalNEW.permanence

NEW Forge-local reconciliation: the created body is permanent ordinary matter; a separately identified rank-9 ongoing Forge application maintains this creation’s magical imprint. No natural expiry, concentration, caster-survival tether or ongoing range limit. Until dispelled applies to that explicit application. This does not make ordinary permanent item enchantments eligible for Greater Dispel. On successful capture/termination of this Forge application, only its imprint ends; the actual damaged mundane body, custody and independent contents remain. No consumed stock returns and no spent effect or damage is undone.

## spellLocalNEW.dispel

The Forge application is a discrete anchor on the created body. Greater Dispel captures that ongoing spell application under its exact 30-foot-center/30-foot-radius snapshot and generating rank 9, one actual spellcasting-ability+PB check against DC28 per generating cast. A class Dispel has its distinct cost/range/DC. No acquired source is inferred from a comparison card. This explicit local spell dependency is not an amendment to all magic-item dispelling.

## spellLocalNEW.suppression

The mundane body remains; intersecting suppression disables the Forge imprint and item magical functions while applicable. NEW: this item-bound application is indivisible when its body intersects the operative field. Charges and damage history persist; clocks continue. A dawn missed while suppressed does not recharge later. Ending suppression restores only a still-live imprint and currently lawful functionality.

## spellLocalNEW.bodyLifecycle

Broken at zero structural HP disables positive mundane/magical functions under the item source; the root survives on the recoverable original main body. Actual destruction or full consumption ends the imprint and tombstones the root. Ordinary repair follows source tools, proficiency, station, material costs, work duration and checks; no recreation of a missing main body or charge reset. Losing a detached required part makes the item incomplete; it does not create another imprinted item. Salvage and partial consumption preserve exact ordinary material lineage; no detached component duplicates magic. Whole-body recipe consumption ends this imprint before the new recipe outcome. Independent socketed/contained objects survive all root endings.

## spellLocalNEW.custody

Actual transfer, sale, salvage and compatible recipe use are allowed; no blanket summon-like zero-value restriction. Reference value remains a reference, not a buyer or guaranteed proceeds. Require an actual available finite buyer, agreed quote and inventory/currency settlement. No new item values or guaranteed market are authored. Recast always creates a new ID; never refill or modify the old body by pretending it is newly created.

Useful authorized comparisons: Standard longsword Refined Gale Sword recipe-42, 3 lb, maximum HP5, base15gp plus process92gp=107gp reference, +1 weapon attack/damage only; no Air damage by title. Field Veiled Bracelet recipe-241, steel wrist-adornment 0.1lb, HP5 AC19, 166/3gp reference, +1 qualifying Stealth-family event and max1 charge; exact equipping, activation, dawn and suppression rules remain in COMPARISON_EVIDENCE. Forge creates one bracelet, not its recipe batch of three.

## spellLocalNEW.geometry

NEW: choose an unoccupied, supported output placement with a complete authorized physical envelope wholly within range/line of effect. Do not materialize inside an actor or displace matter. Revalidate at resolution; if the selected placement becomes unavailable, paid cast fails without output. No safety teleport, attack or collision damage is implied.
